(hooks)#0.sql:
select a.attrelid::text as "table", a.attname as name, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) as type, a.attgenerated <> '' as generated, col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum) as comment
      from pg_attribute a where a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped and a.attrelid::text || ':' || a.attname = any($1::text[])

select p.oid::text as oid, p.proname as name, p.prosrc as source, p.prosecdef as definer from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = $1 and p.prorettype = 'trigger'::regtype

select t.tgrelid::text as "table", format('%I.%I', ns.nspname, c.relname) as "tableSql", t.tgname as name, t.tgfoid::text as "function"
      from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid join pg_namespace ns on ns.oid = c.relnamespace
      where not t.tgisinternal and (t.tgfoid::text = any($1::text[]) or t.tgrelid::text = any($2::text[]))
select c.oid::text as oid, format('%I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname) as sql from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where c.oid = to_regclass($1)
select attname as name, format_type(atttypid, atttypmod) as type from pg_attribute where attrelid = $1::oid and attnum > 0 and not attisdropped
select n.nspname as schema, obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class') as comment from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where c.oid = to_regclass($1)
select p.prosrc as source from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = $1 and p.proname = $2 and p.pronargs = 1 and p.proargtypes[0] = 'timestamptz'::regtype
select bucket, org_id, events::int from readings_hourly order by bucket
select bucket, org_id, events::int from readings_hourly order by bucket
